title: Logarithmic-Space Membership of the Step Language
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean symbols, the language of pair-encoded tuples $(x,c,c',s)$ for which there are configurations on input $x$ with work-tape heads and nonblank contents within radius $s$, whose configuration codes are $c$ and $c'$, and where the second configuration follows from the first in one step of $N$, is decidable in logarithmic space.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols
